summary: All 23 tests in api-orchestrator.test.ts pass. Full GUI regression suite (22 files, 642 tests) passes with no failures. All three acceptance criteria verified.

summary: Reviewed api-orchestrator.test.ts (23 tests) and the WP-008 handler implementations in gui/api.ts. No blocking issues found. Code is clean, maintainable, and consistent with established patterns throughout the file.

Test structure is well-organized with clear describe blocks per handler. Coverage maps cleanly to all 6 acceptance criteria (AC-1 through AC-6). Security path-traversal assertions are present for both kill and dismiss ID validation.

Handler implementations are appropriately thin: assertSafeQueueId() is correctly factored and reused by both handleOrchestratorKill and handleOrchestratorDismiss. All four handlers follow the existing ApiError + notFound/validationError helper pattern.

server.ts route wiring verified: decodeURIComponent is applied to the raw path segment before assertSafeQueueId checks, which is the correct order (decode then validate) to prevent URL-encoding-based bypass attempts.

comments.note: No blocking observations — implementation and tests are clean and consistent with established patterns in api.ts. assertSafeQueueId() correctly mirrors assertSafeWpId() and assertSafeSlug() in structure and behavior.

[documentation-forward] assertSafeQueueId() in gui/api.ts checks for '/' and '..' but not for backslash separators. A brief comment explaining that Windows path separators are not checked because queue IDs are system-generated (not user-controlled file paths) would aid future maintainers auditing the security guard.

notes: 23 tests pass for handleOrchestratorStart, handleGetOrchestratorQueue, handleOrchestratorKill, handleOrchestratorDismiss. Validation, error paths, and success shapes all verified. Full 642-test GUI regression suite clean.
